text_block_list.text:
Today, I was helping Inari One
with her dance practice at a studio, when—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I really just can't get into the mood for this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't mess with me! When it comes to a festival, being the first to dance and carry the shrine is what Inari-sama is all about!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's not it, I just ain't feelin' like dancin' around all timid-like in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only this were the real deal.
Then I could get all hyped up together
with the crowd, but still...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, no use grumblin' about it.
Puttin' in effort behind the scenes is important too, after all.
choice_data_list: In that case, shall I liven things up?
In that case, shall I liven things up?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You sayin' you can actually pull off
a magic trick like that?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're lookin' at Lady Inari herself♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wasshoi, wasshoi♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my body just moved on its own.
You're pretty good, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, keep 'em comin' just like that!
Hype up Lady Inari even more!
Inari One seems to be getting pumped up. Now then, let's take things a step further—
Inari One seems to be getting pumped up. Now then, let's take things a step further—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good!
So, who're ya bringing with you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Osu! The unworthy Bamboo Memory
has arrived to cheer you on, Inari-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray! Inari-senpai!!
Do your best, do your best, stylish gal!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Bamboo, aren't you kind of
missing the point here?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fight, oh!! Fight, oh!!
Inari-senpai, number one in Japan! Inari-senpai, greatest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. Still, they're as passionate as ever, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, forget the small details.
Seeing this is getting me all fired up too.
Lady Inari's gonna dance right along with 'em!!

And so, Inari One danced with all her heart and soul
until she was drenched in sweat!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, quite generous of ya!
Then lend me one, will ya!

And so, I borrowed a taiko drum
from the storage room.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? You're seriously good with those drumsticks!
My body's just moving on its own!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho♪
Heave-ho, heave-ho, just like that!!

And so, Inari One danced to her heart's content,
making it a thoroughly satisfying lesson.
